summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.14/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.14 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 1, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 17¢ lower than a week ago, 40¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.39 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Madison ($3.89) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.31).
